name: Necromancer: Sacrifice Undead kills its minions instead of despawning them (#1435)
contract: Sacrifice Undead 807938 (rank 2 of 805027, family 29 word 2 0x4000000) reads 'Sacrifices your Undead, returning their Life Force to you, and restoring ... health for each Undead minion destroyed.' Spell.dbc: effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE on TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ALLY (up to 25) with 805031, whose description is 'Destroys an Undead minion and heals the caster.' and whose effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_INSTAKILL on TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY (the minion) and effect 1 SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL on the caster. A sacrificed minion therefore dies (death animation, a corpse left behind) instead of being removed from the world, which the client shows as a fade-out. The corpse is observed natively by Cannibalize 20577 (spell_gen_cannibalize), which is refused with SPELL_FAILED_NO_EDIBLE_CORPSES (141) unless a dead Humanoid or Undead (TargetCreatureType 96) that is not friendly to the caster lies within 5 yd (SpellRange 12). An Alliance observer beside the Horde Necromancer is refused while the Lesser Skeletal Warriors (creature type 6, Undead) are alive and must be able to cannibalize their corpses once they are sacrificed, starting its 20578 channel. The Necromancer is still healed once per sacrificed minion and gets its Life Force back.

steps.label: Let login and the Life Force aura settle
Raise the first Lesser Skeletal Warrior
SETUP: one Lesser Skeletal Warrior is raised
Raise the second Lesser Skeletal Warrior
SETUP: two Lesser Skeletal Warriors are raised
Let the minions take their places beside the Necromancer
CONTROL: Cannibalize while the minions live
CONTROL: no corpse lies nearby before the sacrifice
The Necromancer is healed once for each minion destroyed
The Life Force of both minions is returned
Let the sacrificed minions settle as corpses
The sacrificed minions left corpses that can be cannibalized
Cannibalize starts its channel on a sacrificed minion's corpse
The post-sacrifice Cannibalize was not refused
